title: Possible cause for "mscorlib.dll.dll not found" in Godot mono c#
body: ### Tested versions Reproduced version: v3.6.1.stable.mono.official [b1ba98fce] And previous versions. ### System information Godot 3.6.1 Mono OpenGL 2.0 Edition: Windows 10 Pro Version: 22H2 OS Build: 19045.6332 Intel(R) Core(TM) i3-2120 CPU @ 3.30GHz Installed RAM: 8.00 GB Storage: 298 GB HDD ST3320613AS, 466 GB HDD ST500DM002-1BD142 Video Card: NVIDIA GeForce GT 610 (2 GB) System Type: 64-bit operating system, x64-based processor ### Issue description Hello, yesterday I encountered this bizarre "mscorlib.dll.dll not found" issue, which made me rack my brains for a few days trying to solve it. I ended up realizing that when I exported a new project without any .cs files, just the current .csproje and .sln files, and tried to run it, the game would give a "blue screen." When I created a second new project, but including at least one .cs file, the project mysteriously worked, which left me puzzled. I even looked at the 'Assemblies' folder of the compiled project and noticed that the project without a .cs file was missing some .dlls compared to the project that had a .cs file. And so this started when I installed Win10 and the .net and .netframework SDKs. This is the project that gave problems: This is the project that didn't give any problems: ### Steps to reproduce Create a project in Godot 3.6.1 Mono, add the .csproj and .sln files without any .cs files, and export to Windows. Also reproducible in previous versions. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) The project that is in trouble [com.godot.test.inteface2.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23032877/com.godot.test.inteface2.zip) The project that is not in trouble [com.godot.test.inteface3.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23032878/com.godot.test.inteface3.zip)
